name: M6.RecipeIsometries.exchange_laws
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.RecipeIsometries.Block N) (z : M6.RecipeIsometries.Word N), M6.Physical.boundary N b a h = M6.RecipeIsometries.exchange N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) ∧ M6.Physical.syndrome N b a (M6.RecipeIsometries.exchange N z) = M6.Physical.syndrome N a b z
guidance: The boundary pair swaps definitionally. For the syndrome, expand exchange and use commutativity of addition in ZMod2. No module shear is involved. Return tactic proof lines without leading by, retaining the exact frozen statement and default limits.
